svg.aria-label: Recognised: University of Texas at Austin - Security Hall of Fame. Recognised in the University of Texas at Austin Security Hall of Fame (2026) for responsibly disclosing a dangling AWS Elastic Beanstalk CNAME (subdomain takeover candidate) on a utexas.edu host; UT ISO removed the record. 2026-11-19
